title: Jim Keller argues the Moon-landing videos were faked

tellings.quote:
in a debate about the Moonlanding videos
being fake and he will he takes the
their fake side.

plain: The engineer Jim Keller, Michels says, took the "fake" side in a debate about whether the videos of the 1969 Moon landing were staged. Michels tells this himself, as something he knows of Keller, without saying when or where the debate took place beyond the Bay Area. Coming from a respected engineer, it would mean the doubt about the footage is not just a fringe position.
